The engine's inputs

Each link is a generated copy and is not canonical. The file it came from is named beside it, and that file is what the engine reads - `spec/invariants.md`: the data may be replicated in the presentation layer, and no replication is canonical. The copy exists because the published site serves a `.4x` as a download rather than as text, measured: GitHub Pages picks the type from the extension and does not know this one. The twin is written at deploy and is in no clone - `S-134`, scoped by Sean to the published site. Reports

Two of the three views he asks for are here. `docs/process.md`: data is presented to me in both the relational and the physical model, and the console allows both to be inspected and filtered. Every report below says which it is, read from the report rather than from a list beside it. There is no physical view at all - the game's state is plain Rust rather than an ECS, so what a physical view of it should show is a decision rather than a build.

Generated. Every one is derived from the scenario or from the release, and regenerated rather than written. The page is the link; the markdown that made it is beside the name, because a change is reviewed as a diff and a diff of HTML is not one.

  • catalog prose - every kind, with everything the release says about it in one place (markdown)
  • commands relational - every command that ran, flattened out of its files, with the recipe it fired (markdown)
  • containment a tree - what holds what, collapsible, with used against total on every container (markdown)
  • entities relational - the same state as entities and their components (markdown)
  • nogain relational - whether the rules can come back round with more, and the weighting that decides it (markdown)
  • petri relational - the rules as a Petri net: places, transitions, and what cannot be drawn (markdown)
  • recipes the page you browse from - every recipe, with its own lines gathered under it and a worked example beside (markdown)
  • state relational - the state after the scenario, one table per relation (markdown)
  • turns a tree - every turn: the commands that ran, what changed, and what was there (markdown)

Research

Not the game's state, and not generated from it. These are the research lens's files, published beside the reports because nothing else on the site reaches them. Linked at the path they live at, so the link means the same thing in a clone as it does here.

  • ../lenses/research/formulas.html - the specification re-expressed in a small set of primitives, and the world built from an empty game in the same ones
  • ../tools/research/formulas/data.json - the only one of these edited by hand - the report above is generated from it
  • ../tools/research/formulas/results.json - what the three checks last reported
